en: I can't believe it.
I mean, I've been coming here to the O2
since 2009 when the Tour Finals came here.
I don't think I have seen a better match
than that.
It was all on the line, Alex.
Or should I call you Houdini?
How have you won that?
Wow. What a day, huh?
And we're only halfway through it.
Only halfway through it.
Pretty good start for Team World,
but what a place to play some tennis.
This is special.
Thank you guys.
And yeah,
let's just have ourselves a little day, huh?
Alex,
I want to say you literally left it all out there.
Half of your leg is out there.
Yeah. If you can notice my blood is red
as well.
So what can I say?
It was a, you know, a very tough match,
a tough battle.
I left it all out there and got fortunate
in the end to get the job done and happy
to give some points for Team World.
I'm going to have to disagree with you.
You didn't get lucky.
You got tough as nails out there.
You're 6-2 down to the US Open
and the Roland Garros champion.
You're a break down.
He's serving for the match.
How have you turned that around?
Just stay in there, right?
Keep asking questions.
Give yourself a chance
and you never know if you put the ball
in the court, you might get lucky.
So that's what I did today.
You were the first team last year to come
from a deficit on the opening day
of the Laver Cup.
You found yourself down 3-1
after the opening day.
What was the mood in the locker room
when you went back last night?
Yeah, look,
we were in the same position last year,
right?
And it worked out pretty well for us.
So, we know we can do some damage.
We know we're the underdogs,
but we also know that we can step out
on this court and light it up.
So, happy days.
On to the next one and let's see
if we can keep it going.
